steps.title: Prepare qRT-PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble each reaction using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies, Catalog #11732088) following the manufacturer’s instructions, adding the appropriate influenza B Yamagata lineage primers and probe.

steps.title: Program thermal cycler
steps.instruction: Set the cycler to: 50 °C for 5 min, 95 °C for 2 min, then 40 cycles of 95 °C for 3 sec followed by 60 °C for 30 sec with fluorescence acquisition at the end of each 60 °C step.

steps.title: Interpret amplification curves
steps.instruction: A result is positive when the amplification plot shows a sigmoidal curve with an exponential rise, fluorescence intensity above the positive control, and a threshold‑cycle (CT) value that is crossed before cycle 40. A CT of 40 cycles or greater is considered negative. No‑template controls (NTCs) must not produce a curve.
